source.title: Close Enough To Touch
source.description:
These vile necromancers and their tricks, it's disgusting. We must find a way to break through the barrier protecting Arkonos to end him!

Many Cult of the Damned and Scourge spellcasters are known to carry a variety of fell implements and foci of dark magic. Perhaps some of the nearby Shadowmages or Dread Weavers may have something we could use to penetrate the shield?
source.completion: Yes! This might just do it. Let us make haste back to the slaughterhouse and put this device to the test!
